# Tencent Cloud
> Tencent Cloud provides cloud computing services, APIs, SDKs, and technical documentation for infrastructure, AI, media, security, and enterprise applications.

This site hosts Tencent Cloud’s international documentation, product references, developer guides, API materials, SDK resources, and support content for building and operating cloud-based systems.

## Documentation Home
- [Documentation Home](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document): Central entry point for Tencent Cloud product documentation and technical resources.
- [Product Documentation](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product): Browse documentation organized by Tencent Cloud product and service category.
- [API Documentation](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api): Access API references for Tencent Cloud services and versions.
- [Developer Tools](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/tool): Find CLI, SDK, and related developer tooling documentation.
- [Best Practices](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/best-practice): Explore recommended architectures, deployment patterns, and operational guidance.
- [FAQ](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/faq): Read frequently asked questions across Tencent Cloud products and services.

## Getting Started
- [Getting Started](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/213): Introductory materials for creating accounts and using Tencent Cloud services.
- [Quick Start Guides](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/213/4855): Follow initial setup steps for common Tencent Cloud workflows.
- [Account and Identity](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/378): Learn about account management, access control, and identity services.
- [Billing Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/555): Understand billing, payments, and cost management features.
- [Regions and Availability Zones](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/213/6091): Review region selection and deployment geography considerations.
- [Console Overview](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/213/495): Get familiar with the Tencent Cloud management console.

## Compute and Containers
- [Cloud Virtual Machine](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/213): Documentation for provisioning and managing virtual machine instances.
- [Auto Scaling](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/377): Configure elastic scaling policies for compute workloads.
- [Batch Compute](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/599): Run large-scale batch jobs on Tencent Cloud infrastructure.
- [Tencent Kubernetes Engine](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/457): Deploy and operate managed Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications.
- [Serverless Cloud Function](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/583): Build event-driven serverless applications using cloud functions.
- [Lighthouse](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1207): Use simplified cloud servers for lightweight application deployment.

## Networking and CDN
- [Virtual Private Cloud](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/215): Create isolated networks, subnets, and routing configurations.
- [Cloud Load Balancer](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/214): Distribute traffic across backend services with managed load balancing.
- [Content Delivery Network](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/228): Accelerate content delivery using Tencent Cloud’s global CDN.
- [Direct Connect](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/216): Establish dedicated private connectivity to Tencent Cloud resources.
- [NAT Gateway](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/552): Manage outbound internet access for private network resources.
- [DNSPod](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/302): Configure DNS resolution and domain management services.

## Storage and Databases
- [Cloud Object Storage](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/436): Store and retrieve unstructured data with scalable object storage.
- [Cloud Block Storage](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/362): Attach persistent block storage volumes to compute instances.
- [File Storage](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/582): Use managed shared file storage for cloud workloads.
- [TencentDB for MySQL](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/236): Operate managed MySQL databases with backup and scaling features.
- [TencentDB for PostgreSQL](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/409): Deploy and manage PostgreSQL databases on Tencent Cloud.
- [TencentDB for Redis](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/239): Use managed Redis for caching and in-memory data services.
- [TDSQL-C MySQL Edition](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1098): Access cloud-native MySQL-compatible distributed database documentation.

## Security and Identity
- [Cloud Access Management](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/598): Define users, roles, and permissions for Tencent Cloud resources.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/400): Manage certificate issuance, deployment, and lifecycle operations.
- [Web Application Firewall](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/627): Protect web applications against common attacks and threats.
- [Anti-DDoS](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1029): Mitigate distributed denial-of-service attacks on internet-facing services.
- [Cloud Firewall](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1130): Control network traffic and enforce security policies across environments.
- [Security Operations Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/296): Monitor, detect, and respond to cloud security risks.

## Media, AI, and Communications
- [Cloud Streaming Services](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/267): Build live streaming workflows with ingest, processing, and playback.
- [Video on Demand](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/266): Manage media upload, transcoding, storage, and distribution pipelines.
- [Media Processing Service](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/862): Automate media transcoding, editing, and content processing tasks.
- [Real-Time Communication](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/647): Integrate audio, video, and interactive communication capabilities.
- [Chat](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1047): Add instant messaging and conversation features to applications.
- [Machine Translation](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/551): Use translation APIs for multilingual text processing.
- [Text Moderation](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1125): Detect and manage inappropriate text content programmatically.

## API and SDK Resources
- [API Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api): Browse Tencent Cloud API references by product.
- [API Explorer](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1278): Test APIs online and inspect request parameters and responses.
- [SDK Center](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/sdk): Find official SDKs for supported programming languages.
- [Command Line Interface](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/440): Install and use the Tencent Cloud CLI for automation.
- [Signature v3](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1278/57484): Learn request signing requirements for Tencent Cloud APIs.
- [Error Codes](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/1278/44574): Reference common API error handling information.
